chunks: I heard Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام saying:
Alif Lām Mīm. Do the people reckon that they will be left alone to say, “We believe,” while they will not be tested?

Then he عليه السلام said to me, “What is the trial?” I said, “May I be sacrificed for you عليه السلام, according to us it is the trial in the religion.” So he عليه السلام said, “They will be tested just as gold is tested.” Then he عليه السلام said, “They will be purified just as gold is purified.”

key_terms.آمَنَّا: We believe; the profession of faith being tested
key_terms.الدِّينِ: The religion; the sphere in which the believers are tested
key_terms.الذَّهَبُ: Gold; used as the example of something refined through testing
key_terms.الْفِتْنَةُ: The trial or testing, here understood as testing in religion
key_terms.يُخْلَصُونَ: They are purified; they are made pure after testing
key_terms.يُفْتَنُونَ: They are tested; they undergo trial and examination

ai.seo_question: What does the trial of believers mean in Qur'an 29:2 according to Imam Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith explains that believers are not left without trial after professing faith. The Imam عليه السلام clarifies that this fitnah is a refining test in religion, like gold being tested and purified. Its significance lies in showing that trials distinguish and purify true iman.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Moammar Bn Khallad who said, 
‘I heard Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘
[29:2] Do the people reckon that they will be left alone on saying, We believe, and they will not be Tested?’

Then he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘What is ‘الْفِتْنَةُ’ the strife?’ I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! That which is with us is the strife regarding the Religion’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘They would be refined as gold is refined’. Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘They would be purified just as gold is purified’.
en.sarwar: 4. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Mu‘ammar ibn al-Khallad who has said the following. “I heard abu al-Hassan (a.s.) say, “Do people think they will not be tested because they say, “We have faith?” [29:2].
Then he said, “Do you know what al-Fitna, trial is?” I said, May Allah take my soul in service for your cause, in our opinion it is the trial and test in religion.
The Imam (a.s.) said, “They will be test and refined as gold is tested.” He then said, “They will be purified as gold is purified and refined.”
